meta_description: VpnHood! – A free, secure, and open-source VPN with a global server network designed to protect your online privacy and ensure secure access to the web.
page_desc: Fast, secure, and reliable VPN solution powered by VpnHood! Engine, which is open-source and the first VPN developed fully with the .NET platform.
intro: VpnHood! CLIENT is the free, open-source app your users install — on Android, Android TV, Windows, and Linux. It is built so the person holding the key needs no explanation:
li_key: Paste a key, done. Add an access key and you are connected — no account, no sign-up, nothing to configure.
li_fast: Fast and light. Powered by VpnHood! ENGINE, with speed to spare for streaming and video calls.
li_protocol: Steadfast protocol. Holds a smooth, encrypted connection steady on networks that keep trying to drop it, over IPv4 and IPv6 alike.
li_cloak: Cloak Mode. Dresses the tunnel as ordinary web traffic — a censor probing the connection gets a plain web-server reply instead of anything worth blocking.
li_proxy: Proxy Mode. Blocked from connecting directly? Reach your server through a SOCKS or HTTP proxy, or relay through another network entirely.
li_split: Split tunneling. Choose what goes through the VPN — by app, IP address, domain, or country — so local apps like banking keep working untouched.
screenshot_home_alt: VpnHood! CLIENT on a phone, connected, showing live download and upload speed with split tunneling and protocol options
screenshot_servers_alt: The Servers screen in VpnHood! CLIENT, listing a public and a private access-key profile with their server locations
win_title: The same app on your desktop
win_desc: VpnHood! CLIENT runs on Windows and Linux too — the interface you know, in a compact window that stays out of the way. Paste an access key once, and your servers are a click away.
